FUND-017.title: C-CAMP receives a ₹500 crore RDI Fund commitment
FUND-017.details:
**Announcement date:** 16 October 2026

entity["organization","Centre for Cellular and Molecular Platforms","Bengaluru biotech research and innovation organisation"]

The central government's Research, Development and Innovation Fund has selected C-CAMP as one of five Focused Research Organisations, with a reported **₹500 crore commitment**. C-CAMP plans to work with private partners and investors to assemble a consortium exceeding ₹1,000 crore. citeturn3view7

| Field | Details |
|---|---|
| Amount | ₹500 crore commitment |
| Type | Government RDI allocation to a research and innovation organisation |
| Lead investor | Not applicable; this is not a venture-capital equity round |
| Co-investors | Individual private partners not named in the checked report |
| Intended use | Support deep-tech life sciences in healthcare, agriculture, food security and environmental sustainability |
| Eligibility signal | Technologies at Technology Readiness Level 4 and above, according to the repo

FUND-015.title: OXG Space raises ₹17 crore
FUND-015.details:
entity["company","OXG Space","Bengaluru satellite connectivity startup"] · Official site: urlOXG Spaceturn11search7

**Announcement date:** 14 October 2026  
**Amount:** ₹17 crore  
**Round stage:** Not stated in the source  
**Lead investor:** entity["company","Aum Ventures","Indian venture capital firm"], through India Innovation Fund II  
**Other participants:** entity["company","Skyroot Aerospace","Indian private launch vehicle company"] co-founders Pawan Kumar Chandana and Naga Bharath Daka, and Dr Chiran Phanindra.

The reported round will support Mission Synapse, a 12-month in-orbit demonstration of satellite communication and power systems, including a Ka-band phased-array antenna, deployable mesh reflector and scalable solar array. citeturn2view2

FUND-014.title: Hunar.AI raises ₹40 crore
FUND-014.details:
entity["company","Hunar.AI","conversational AI platform for frontline workforce management"]

**Announcement date:** 19 October 2026  
**Round:** Series A  
**Amount:** ₹40 crore  
**Lead investor:** entity["company","Blume Ventures","Indian venture capital firm"]

Other participants named in the report include entity["company","Together Fund","AI-focused venture capital fund"], entity["company","Seedstars","startup investment and support organisation"], entity["company","AVNM Ventures","venture capital firm"] and other investors. The report says the round takes the company's total funding to ₹65 crore. citeturn1view1

Hunar's official website also lists a Bengaluru office in HSR Layout, establishing its local presence. citeturn3search3

FUND-012.title: Fundamentum Fund III
FUND-012.details:
entity["company","Fundamentum Frontier Advisors","Indian venture capital fund manager"]

**Announcement date:** 19 October 2026  
**Amount raised:** ₹3,000 crore  
**Fundraising ceiling:** ₹3,500 crore  
**Type:** Venture capital fundraise, not a startup equity round

Today's report says the fund has secured ₹3,000 crore and raised its fundraising ceiling following strong demand. The manager was negotiating with institutional investors for an additional ₹500 crore, with the final close expected within two months. citeturn3view0
